title: Screenshots the documentation expects
description: Declares which screenshots the app's automated flow produces, so a missing image fails a check instead of appearing as a broken picture in a published guide. The capturing test writes files; this manifest states what the documentation is allowed to reference.

id.description: File name without extension, as written by the capturing test. Referenced from guides as {{screenshot:<id>}}.

caption.description: Localized captions, keyed by locale. Also used as the image alt text, so it must describe the screen rather than repeat the file name.

profiles.description: Profiles this shot is captured in. Defaults to every declared profile.

optional.description: When true, a missing image is a warning rather than an error. For shots behind a permission or a device capability that CI cannot reach.
